case.summary: Customer C08106 reported $128.33 online charge (2016-12-29) as not made by them. Model scored 0.17 fraud probability on card-not-present-new-device pattern (initial 0.04); card history shows 4 prior cases (3 confirmed fraud). Customer repeated denial; device is new to this card. Verdict uncertain. Card blocked, case escalated to analyst.
